name: Eire

attributes.attribute: another name for the land of Ireland, tied to Ériu

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eire is an old name for Ireland. The spelling Érie also occurs in the texts. It sends the reader to the goddess and to the longer entry for Ériu. See Ériu.

okr.objective: Send the reader from the short name Eire to the fuller entry for Ériu.
key_results: Eire is another name for the land of Ireland.
The old spelling Érie also occurs.
See the longer entry for Ériu.
